work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act empowers Bishop James Bramston, vicar apostolic of London, to choose and consecrate a titular bishop as replacement visitor for Mauritius. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7024; own dating clause LF7109–7112 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die nona augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF7040 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
